items.name: 抱抱
items.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one square product-cover illustration for a private couple's affection-reward mini shop.
Primary request: 卡通，可爱，幸福，情侣日常互动，微信可爱表情包风格。
Style: simple adorable hand-drawn 2D cartoon sticker illustration, slightly wobbly clean dark warm-gray outlines, large white rounded heads and plump marshmallow bodies, tiny dot eyes or curved happy eyes, very short limbs, soft peach-pink blush. An original pair of tiny white bear-like dumpling creatures with two very small rounded ears, no clothes or accessories. Same character design for both, one slightly taller than the other. Minimal flat colors, delicate warm shading only, no realistic fur, no 3D, no detailed background, no lettering.
Composition: 1:1 square, single centered scene, characters and gesture large and instantly legible at small thumbnail size, generous clean warm-white background and 12% safe margin, soft little ground shadow, a few small pale pink hearts where appropriate. Sweet sincere domestic happiness, comforting affection, playful expressions. No border, no panel grid, no typography, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. High-quality crisp drawing, not blurry.

Scene: Two little white dumpling bears giving each other a snug full-body hug, cheek to cheek, eyes happily closed. The shorter one nestles into the taller one's chest; tiny arms visibly wrap around one another with clear simple anatomy. Three small pink hearts rise above. A tender happy embrace.
